# Edulocus Coach & Consultants

> Nagpur-based education consultant, admission consultant and career counsellor offering career counselling, college planning, and study-abroad guidance (MBBS, Engineering, Management) across India and overseas. Founded 2012 by Atish Gupta. Rated 4.9★ across 289 Google reviews.

## Services
- Career discovery: psychometric testing and 1:1 counselling
- College planning: shortlisting, applications, scholarship guidance
- Study abroad: MBBS and higher education in Russia, Germany, USA, UK, Canada, Australia; visa filing and forex support
- Programs: MBBS abroad, Engineering, Management (MBA) admissions in India and overseas
